landing.title: You are invited to send files
landing.text: {inviter} invites you to send files with this service. The files you send will be addressed to them.
landing.message: Message from the person who invited you
landing.next: To continue, you will receive a verification code at your email address.

invalid.title: Invitation not found
invalid.text: This invitation link is not valid. Check that you copied it completely from the email.

expired.title: Invitation expired
expired.text: This invitation has expired or is no longer valid. Ask the person who invited you for a new invitation.

invite.title: Invite an external person
invite.intro: The person you invite will be able to send you files: they will be addressed to {inviter}.
invite.email: Email address of the person to invite
invite.messageHint: Optional. Included in the invitation email.
invite.languageHint: The email is written in this language.
invite.rateLimited: You have sent too many invitations in the last hour.
invite.refused: This invitation cannot be sent. Check the address or contact your administrator.

sent.title: Invitation sent
sent.text: An invitation was sent to {email}. The link stays valid for 12 months if it is not used.

noSession.title: Identify yourself first
noSession.text: Only internal users identified on the sending page can invite external people. Identify yourself with your work email address from the network of your organisation, then come back to this page.

notAllowed.title: Invitations not available
notAllowed.text: Your address is not allowed to send invitations. Only internal users connected from the network of your organisation can invite external people.
